title: Don't Answer the Phone
hook: I got trapped in a Pulsebox game. Rule 4: never answer the phone at 2 AM

messages.text: Jay clicked play on Night Shift... and woke up behind the counter of the Starlite. Wearing the uniform.
messages.label: STARLITE · ROUTE 9 · 11:04 PM

messages.text: No. No no no no. I'm in the game... I'm actually inside the game!
Taped to the register: the manager's clipboard. Four rules. Signed... D.
milo i'm the cashier in NIGHT SHIFT 😭
follow EVERY rule on that clipboard. the last clerk didn't. his name was *danny*
At exactly two in the morning, the store phone rang. And rang. Then the answering machine picked up.
messages.label: 2:00 AM

messages.text: Hey... it's Danny. I'm still here. Pick up. Please... pick up.
Don't pick up. Don't pick up. Don't pick up...
At 3:33, a car rolled up to pump four. Headlights on. Nobody inside. Then pump four... turned on by itself.
messages.label: 3:33 AM

messages.text: I didn't touch it! I swear I didn't touch it!
Then the door chimed. A customer. Jay glanced at the glass door. He had a reflection. The customer... didn't.
messages.label: 3:41 AM

messages.text: Look down. Look at the floor. Don't look at it.
Long grey fingers tapped on the counter. Tap. Tap. Tap. Jay didn't look up. Not once.
Then the lights flickered. Once. Twice. Three times.
messages.label: 4:12 AM

messages.text: The door! Lock the door! LOCK THE DOOR!
Jay held that lock until the sky turned pink. Five AM. Shift over... and he woke up at his desk.
messages.label: 5:00 AM

messages.text: Then his phone rang. Two AM. Caller ID... Danny.
messages.label: 2:00 AM

messages.text: Night Shift and eight more horror games, free on Pulsebox. box.pulseform.org. It's a computer game site, so play it on a computer. And at two AM... don't answer the phone.
